```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson", simplifyVector = FALSE)
length(raw$features)

fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(fire)

first_coordinate <- fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
first_coordinate
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, regex("\\bAugust\\b", ignore_case = TRUE))) |>
  nrow()

fires |>
  arrange(desc(gis_acres)) |>
  select(incident, gis_acres) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    coordinates = map(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      matrix(unlist(coordinates), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
    }),
    lon = map_dbl(coordinates, \(coordinates) mean(coordinates[, 1])),
    lat = map_dbl(coordinates, \(coordinates) mean(coordinates[, 2]))
  )

big_fires <- big_fires |>
  select(-coordinates)

```

```{r}
top_big_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)

top_fire_geometries <- sf::st_sfc(
  map(top_big_fires$geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
    sf::st_polygon(map(coordinates, \(ring) {
      matrix(unlist(ring), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
    }))
  }),
  crs = 4326
)

top_fire_shapes <- sf::st_sf(
  top_big_fires |> select(-geometry_coordinates),
  geometry = top_fire_geometries
)

bounds <- sf::st_bbox(top_fire_shapes)
lon_padding <- (bounds["xmax"] - bounds["xmin"]) * 0.02
lat_padding <- (bounds["ymax"] - bounds["ymin"]) * 0.02

leaflet(top_fire_shapes) |>
  addTiles() |>
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = bounds["xmin"] - lon_padding,
    lat1 = bounds["ymin"] - lat_padding,
    lng2 = bounds["xmax"] + lon_padding,
    lat2 = bounds["ymax"] + lat_padding
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    popup = ~paste(incident, "-", fire_year, "-", round(gis_acres), "acres")
  )
```
